home.heroSubtitle: Estimate true seller margins and seller profits across Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop, Shopify, Flipkart, and payment platforms with transparent formulas and adjustable fee rates.
home.trueMarginExplanation: True margin is your actual profit after subtracting all costs: product cost, shipping, platform fees, payment processing fees, advertising spend, refunds, and other expenses. Many sellers only look at revenue minus product cost, but the real picture includes every fee and deduction that reduces your bottom line.
home.whyItMattersExplanation: Understanding your true margin helps you make informed pricing decisions, identify unprofitable products, optimize advertising spend, and build a sustainable business. Without accurate margin calculations, you might be losing money on sales you thought were profitable.

faq.question: Are these calculators free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, all calculators are completely free with no login required.

faq.question: How accurate are the calculations?
faq.answer: Our calculators provide estimates based on the fee rates you enter. Actual fees may vary based on product category, seller status, and platform policy changes. Always verify with official platform documentation.

faq.question: Can I save my calculations?
faq.answer: Currently, calculations are not saved. We recommend bookmarking the page or taking screenshots for reference.

faq.question: Do you support other platforms?
faq.answer: We plan to add more platforms in the future. Currently we support Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop, Shopify, and general payment fee calculations.
